truth.the_law_this_round_adds: Breadth buys what repetition cannot, and then stops. Repetition saturates at a machine's resolving power; breadth halves the goal's class and adds behaviours, then saturates too, at a residual that is a property of what the environments can exhibit. That residual is a class of minimal statements and its size is a price in words: log2(class) questions the user must answer, none of which any run can answer.
